invocation.description: Caller sets JACGRID_WORKDIR to a directory containing task.json (Contract B task envelope) and runs `jac run src/embed.jac`. Per docs/luke-sandbox/spec.md §3: on success the entrypoint writes application output plus reserved __jacgrid_execution.runtime to result.json and exits 0; the generic sandbox validates that tag against this immutable manifest's runtime_tags, promotes it into execution.runtime, strips the reserved object, and wraps the application output into the full Contract B result envelope. On any failure, result.json is NOT written, an error is printed, and the process exits non-zero — the sandbox's own 'runner exits non-zero / bad output -> error' path builds the error envelope from that.

env.JACGRID_WORKDIR: absolute path to a writable scratch directory

invocation.on_success: result.json = {"results": [{"id": ..., "embedding": [...]}], "__jacgrid_execution": {"runtime": "connection-embedding:1.0.0|connection-embedding-fallback:1.0.0"}}, exit 0. The generic sandbox validates the reserved runtime against this manifest's runtime_tags, promotes it into Contract B execution.runtime, and removes it before returning application output.
invocation.on_failure: result.json NOT written, stderr has a human-readable message, exit code != 0

model.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
model.artifact_hash_of: model.safetensors in the pinned revision's snapshot (the primary weight file; the full snapshot is pinned via `revision`, which is what src/embed.jac actually passes to SentenceTransformer(..., revision=...))
model.precision: float32, cast to Python float before serialization

runtime_versions.fallback_trigger: sentence-transformers import failure, model load failure, or any exception during encode() — the workload always produces contract-shaped `results`, whichever path ran.
runtime_versions.fallback_scheme: deterministic seeded SHA-256 bag-of-words hash, L2-normalized, 384-d (same dimensionality as the primary model so downstream consumers never branch on it)
runtime_versions.visibility: the on-disk result.json carries the actual tag only in reserved `__jacgrid_execution.runtime`. The generic sandbox accepts it only when it appears in this manifest's runtime_tags, promotes it to Contract B execution.runtime, and removes the reserved field before exposing application output. Workloads cannot claim arbitrary runtimes.

model.description: informational only — this workload always runs its own pinned model/revision

on_failure_contract.description: On failure this workload writes NO result.json at all and exits non-zero (stderr carries the reason) — it does not attempt to construct any part of the Contract B envelope. See docs/luke-sandbox/spec.md §3's Failure mapping table for how the sandbox turns that into a result envelope.

resource_requirements.notes: matches docs/architecture.md §5's example task-envelope limits; measured actual usage on the reference fixture (3 items) was ~500MB peak RSS / ~2.6 cpu_seconds on the primary model path on this dev machine.

verification.tolerance_rationale: the pinned model + normalize_embeddings=True is deterministic per-machine, but float32 BLAS reductions can differ in the last few bits across CPU/GPU backends (MPS vs CPU vs different worker hardware); 0.999 cosine similarity (equivalently, ~0.001 max per-pair distance, matching the flat `tolerance` field above) comfortably separates 'same embedding, different hardware' from 'wrong embedding'. Exact bit-for-bit equality is NOT the bar.
verification.runtime_mismatch_policy: if a recompute lands on the fallback runtime while the original ran on the primary model (or vice versa), verification MUST fail regardless of similarity score — the two schemes are not expected to agree.

task_embedding_3profiles.description: 3 short bio-style texts. expected_primary was generated once by running this exact entrypoint against the pinned model/revision offline; expected_fallback is independently computed in Python from the same hash formula as _hash_embed and must match exactly (deterministic, no model involved).

task_bad_job_type.description: job_type outside this workload's allowlist must fail fast (non-zero exit, no result.json), not raise or hang.
